subject.title: Upgrade 2026.6.8→2026.6.9 corrupts email channel config with spurious groupAllowFrom field

question: Should maintainers land the narrow schema-verified doctor guard in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95540 for this issue, or wait for a broader config-protection direction?
rationale: The bug is valid and the fix PR is focused, but changing core doctor from permissive to fail-closed for schemaless external channel repairs is compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Land the narrow guard
options.body: Merge the active PR after normal gates because core should not write unverified keys into external plugin config.

options.title: Add an external opt-in contract
options.body: Pause the fix and design a plugin doctor/schema capability if maintainers want non-bundled channels to opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede with broader protection
options.body: Use broader config-protection work only if it proves the same external email/RCS regression and remains mergeable.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow guard
recommendation.body: Merge the active PR after normal gates because core should not write unverified keys into external plugin config.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner introduced the fallback migration and is the strongest history signal for deciding the compatibility tradeoff in that doctor path.
